title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording capturing a juicy Slipknot/Eyes jam and an overall mellow set of jams from the March 28, 1973 show.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its great sound quality, delivering a crisp capture of the standout Slipknot → Eyes jam. Reviewers also note that the performance is a nice, mellow set of jams throughout the night. While one reviewer gave a zero‑star rating without comment, the consensus highlights both the musical and technical strengths.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight superb sound quality and strong jam performances, outweighing a single uninformative zero‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp mix with a juicy Slipknot/Eyes jam; no reported dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, jam‑focused set that flows smoothly, highlighted by the Slipknot/Eyes transition.
